description: Croatian company insolvency status from the official Sudski registar (court register, daily snapshot of the open API, under the source's own terms): running procedure (bankruptcy or stečaj, liquidation, pre-bankruptcy stages, bankruptcy or liquidation estate) and every published court decision with its extracted facts (court, case reference, date), never the decision text. `aucune_procedure: true` is a measured fact on the complete snapshot. Unknown OIB/MBS = 404 (deleted subjects are not published by the API). A sole trader (trgovac pojedinac, t.p.) or an undecided legal form returns 404, not billed; so does a name covered by an objection. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

oib.description: 11-digit Croatian OIB (e.g. 92803032010); an 8- or 9-digit MBS court-register number is accepted too

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_croatian_company_insolvency

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Croatian company insolvency (Sudski registar)
